title: Grateful Dead Live at West Palm Beach Auditorium on 1982-09-11
lineage: Cassette Master (Sony TC-K677ES) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) ->Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/16
source: Beyer M160 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell MX-90)

ai_review.summary: Warm, well‑balanced audience recording captures a high‑energy 9/11/82 show highlighted by a scorching Scarlet > Fire transition and soaring Let It Grow.
ai_review.review: The audience (AUD) tape is praised for its warm low end and balanced mix, giving listeners an immersive feel of the Florida venue. Musically the concert bursts with energy—fans single out the blistering Scarlet Begonias → Fire on the Mountain sequence and a rapturous Let It Grow through Terrapin Station as show‑highlights. Overall the performance feels tight and cohesive, making it a strong recommendation for both newcomers and seasoned Deadheads.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for the show’s energy and standout songs (70% weight) plus generally good recording quality despite a few minor mix comments (30% weight) yields an overall rating in the upper‑four‑star range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm, well‑balanced sound with plenty of low end; clear instrument separation but some reviewers note that a matrix mix could improve balance between audience ambience and direct sources.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert maintains high momentum, with a seamless transition from Scarlet into Fire that fuels the room’s energy and a later Let It Grow that showcases tight band interplay.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals clear; a few minor bum notes in Scarlet but overall strong performance and prominent presence in the mix.
